schemas.ledger:
INPUT DOCUMENTATION v1 (identical across languages). Inputs are JSON objects. Integers below are JSON integers, not strings, floats or booleans. Arrays preserve order. The harness converts this wire representation to the run signature; this is not language syntax.
Fields: initial: integer in [0,1000000]; events: array of at most32 pairs [kind,amount]. kind is integer0=Credit(amount),1=Debit(amount),2=Lock,3=Unlock. amount is an integer in [-1000000,1000001]; for Lock/Unlock it is ignored. The pair encoding maps to Event values before run; it is not a tuple parameter passed directly to run.
schemas.scheduler:
INPUT DOCUMENTATION v1 (identical across languages). Inputs are JSON objects. Integers below are JSON integers, not strings, floats or booleans. Arrays preserve order. The harness converts this wire representation to the run signature; this is not language syntax.
Fields: budget: integer in [0,512]; jobs: array of at most24 objects, each with exactly id,cost,deps. id: integer, all job IDs together are exactly0..n-1 in any array order. cost: integer in [0,64]. deps: array of at most24 valid job IDs; repeats, self-references and cycles are allowed. deps are IDs, not array positions.
schemas.frames:
INPUT DOCUMENTATION v1 (identical across languages). Inputs are JSON objects. Integers below are JSON integers, not strings, floats or booleans. Arrays preserve order. The harness converts this wire representation to the run signature; this is not language syntax.
Fields: limit: integer in [0,64]; data: even-length hexadecimal string encoding at most512 raw bytes, two hexadecimal digits per byte. Input hex accepts either letter case; output bytes use lowercase hex. Decode data before calling run: the string is not UTF-8 payload text, a decimal number, or one byte per digit. An empty string encodes zero bytes. All offsets and lengths in the program count decoded bytes.

note: These exact strings are appended once in schema/both arms. They are wire encodings, not Lobo syntax.
